canonical_queue.binding_basis: The six rendered titles match TP C01-C06 exactly. Upload order is reversed relative to card order, so every image is bound by title.

rejected_queue.reason: Its title sequence describes a different six-card plan and does not match the renders.

audit_policy.content_truth_track: Content truth is audited against the source PDF before upload: numbers, direction, scope, uncertainty, causal structure and conclusion wording must remain faithful.
audit_policy.render_fidelity_track: Render fidelity is audited after upload: reasonable paraphrase, abbreviation and synonymous wording pass when meaning is preserved. Fail only for meaning drift, an unauthorized substantive claim or number, a required_objects/required_relations violation, or a citation_binding exact_once violation.
audit_policy.legacy_exact_text_track: The former literal visible_text whitelist is retained as a non-gating diagnostic only; verbatim wording is not required for render fidelity.
global_constraints_checked: no completed-public-release claim for the 4,978-record local collection
no use of 61.9% as RAG or end-to-end baseline performance
no averaging of strict joint success
no claim that every question is multi-paper
no evidence-state grading invented for evidence object classes

summary.interpretation: C03, C04 and C06 are clean under the user's targeted audit. C01 is source-aligned; its extra oracle explanations remain only in the non-gating legacy exact-text diagnostic. C02 invents evidence-status grades for object types, and C05 presents a venue chart that omits ICCV and reverses the source ranking.

標籤與框線表示內容功能；小標記表示證據狀態。
